detect_adsorbate_dissociation: use DetectTrajAnomaly to check if an adsorbate has dissociated during a relaxation trajectory
detect_surface_reconstruction: use DetectTrajAnomaly to detect if the surface has reconstructed during a relaxation trajectory
detect_adsorbate_desorption: use DetectTrajAnomaly to check if an adsorbate has desorbed from the surface slab
detect_adsorbate_intercalation: use DetectTrajAnomaly to detect if an adsorbate is interacting with frozen bulk atoms
compute_connectivity_matrix: use DetectTrajAnomaly to compute the connectivity matrix of an ASE Atoms object
